1.1.0.description:
## New:
- Added coinsanity! This provides an option to add checks to every single penny coin on each level. You can also choose to just add checks to full clearing the coins in levels that have them, which can add about 30-40 extra checks overall, as a much less intense option. Coins that are green have not yet been sent, so you can keep track of which ones you need to get.
- Added a new macguffin goal! Collect enough `Cannium Prism` items to unlock your goal level, the amount you need and the amount added into the world is customizable in your yaml!
- Added the option to play 4-18 as your goal level, which is a level with no gameplay. This is nice if you don't want to have to finish on a hard level.

## Changes:
- Changed beating the goal level to take you to the P-18 endscreen, to add some extra celebration to your goal!
- Changed disabled worlds and levels to display in red on the level select.

1.2.0.description:
## New:
- Added a custom modifier icon for Uncanny Cat Spray, drawn by yours truly with my own hand

## Changes:
- Changed Uncanny Cat Spray to actually do something! It now protects you once from death from the uncanny cat. It does not come back upon restarting though, so use it wisely! (This functionality can be turned off via a new yaml option "Buff Uncanny Cat Spray", which on by default)
- Changed Uncanny Cat Spray to fill up 50% of the filler with temp modifiers on, rather than being completely replaced (helps cut down on intense amounts of temp modifiers)
- Removed deathlink amnesty as a yaml option. This is now something you exclusively change within the games config menu.
- Increased the deathlink amnesty cap from 10 to 50.

## Fixes:
- Fixed certain costumes unlocking through their vanilla methods
- Fixed the deathlink config option not functioning properly and not reading the yaml option correctly when using "Use Yaml Setting".

[Mod Link](https://github.com/Jeffdev-Archipelago-Implementations/UncannyCatAP/releases/latest)
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/Jeffdev-Archipelago-Implementations/Archipelago-UCG/blob/main/worlds/ucg/docs/setup_en.md)
